preconditions.description: The number of bowls of food n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The time when the dog is stopped T is between 1 and 2,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= 1000000000 for t_i in t)
preconditions.description: Each time t_i when the i-th bowl of food is ready for eating is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The maximum number of bowls of food the dog will be able to eat is between 0 and n inclusive.
The return value is the maximum number of bowls of food the dog can eat in T seconds given the times t_i when each bowl is ready.
